messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] NOMADS outage on Jan. 5-6
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

NOMADS will be down for facility maintenance starting at 1500z on Jan 5 to
approximately 0300z on January 6th.

rNOMADS will not be able to retrieve data during that time.

Thanks,

Danny
